# FDG9013

> CONSIDER making changes to aggregate components’ modes automatic.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a component switches its modes automatically is behavior that needs the design.

## From the book

For example, a single instance of `MessageQueue` can be used to send and receive messages, but the user should not be aware that mode switching is occurring.
